track_split_after_zhongkao.policy_note: 普职比大体相当 (roughly 50:50) was the long-standing policy target (e.g. 国务院 2019 职教20条). The 2021 中办/国办 opinion on modern vocational education replaced it with 协调发展, and the 2022 revised 职业教育法 dropped mandatory 分流 wording in favour of 职普协调发展. Parents' anxiety over forced diversion at 中考 remains a public debate. Actual intake today is ~67:33 (NBS basis) to ~74:26 (MOE basis). [Policy history from background knowledge; not re-verified this session: confidence low]

cohort_attainment_estimate.source: Own estimate: 2025 MOE intakes / single-year cohort. Cohort = census 2020 age-13 population 1667.7万 (CENSUS table 3-1; these people turn 18 in 2025).
cohort_attainment_estimate.note: Calc: 本科 direct entrants (503.71+15.41)=519.12万 → 31.1% of cohort; + 专升本 90.08万 → 36.5% eventually 本科. 专科 entrants (551.70+58.74)=610.44万 → 36.6%; minus those upgrading via 专升本 → 31.2% 专科-only. Caveats: entrants include 复读/older students; adult and online education (308万+148万 a year) add credentials later; some go abroad. Using the age 13-14 average instead gives 37.1% / 31.7%. Treat as ±3 points.

provincial_gaokao_difficulty.note: Not collected: the search budget ran out. This is messy in any case. Provinces don't publish comparable 本科录取率; numbers circulating online usually divide 本科 places by registrants, and registrant counts include 职教高考 and 复读. A defensible proxy is each province's 本科 招生计划 / 普通高考 registrants, with large differences between provinces (e.g. 北京/上海/天津 high; 河南/广西/贵州 etc. lower). Treat any figure as illustrative only.
